nodes.description: Constructor of Fuego: sets MAX_FUEGO and derives REVEAL_TIMESTAMP from saleStart + 90000*9.
onlyOwner function that splits the contract balance across withdrawAddresses by withdrawPercents using low-level send.
onlyOwner function that _safeMints 20 tokens to msg.sender in a loop.
onlyOwner setter that overwrites REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
onlyOwner setter that writes FUEGO_PROVENANCE.
onlyOwner setter forwarding baseURI to _setBaseURI.
onlyOwner toggle of saleIsActive.
Payable public mint: validates sale state, per-tx cap, max supply and ETH value, then _safeMints in a loop and may set startingIndexBlock.
Public function deriving startingIndex from blockhash(startingIndexBlock) modulo MAX_FUEGO.
onlyOwner fallback that sets startingIndexBlock to block.number while startingIndex is still unset.
Public provenance hash string for the collection.
Block number used as the entropy source for the reveal index.
Derived offset used for the reveal shuffle.
Constant mint price of 0.02 ETH.
Constant maximum number of tokens mintable per transaction (20).
Maximum NFT supply.
Boolean gate controlling whether minting is allowed.
Timestamp after which the reveal index block may be set.
Array of payout addresses for withdrawAll.
Array of payout percentages (95, 5) for withdrawAll.
Caller address; used as mint recipient, ownership check and payout trigger.
Miner-influenceable timestamp compared against REVEAL_TIMESTAMP in mintFuego.
Low-level payable(...).send(amount) to withdrawAddresses[i], only the boolean result is required.
_safeMint performs an external call to IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on the recipient.
Price/supply arithmetic: FuegoPrice.mul(numberOfTokens) and totalSupply().add(numberOfTokens).
startingIndex derived from blockhash(startingIndexBlock), a miner/validator influenceable value.
Caller supplied value written into REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
Caller supplied value written into FUEGO_PROVENANCE.
Caller supplied value forwarded to _setBaseURI.
User controlled number of tokens requested in mintFuego.
Loop counter of the mint loop.
Token id derived from totalSupply() for each minted token.
Snapshot of totalSupply() used as the base token id.
Loop counter of the reserve mint loop.
Cached address(this).balance used as the payout base.
Loop counter over withdrawAddresses.
Computed per-recipient payout amount.
ERC721 token name passed to the base constructor.
ERC721 token symbol passed to the base constructor.
Deploy time max supply assigned to MAX_FUEGO.
Deploy time sale start used to compute REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.

edges.reason: mintFuego forwards msg.sender as the recipient of _safeMint, so an attacker controlled contract receives the onERC721Received callback.
msg.sender becomes the callee of the external onERC721Received callback invoked by _safeMint.
mintFuego executes the external call _safeMint inside a loop with state only partially finalised.
reserveFuego calls _safeMint in a loop, invoking the receiver callback for every token.
reserveFuego mints to msg.sender, giving the caller callback execution during the loop.
The IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received callback can re-enter mintFuego before the sale/extent state settles.
The receiver callback can re-enter reserveFuego and mint additional tokens.
The recipient of the low-level send can re-enter withdrawAll before the loop completes.
mintFuego performs price multiplication and supply addition that must be overflow safe.
The required payment is computed by multiplying FuegoPrice by the user supplied token count.
Supply arithmetic is compared against MAX_FUEGO to cap the collection size.
mintFuego reads FuegoPrice to compute the ETH required from msg.value.
mintFuego bounds numberOfTokens by maxFuegoPurchase.
mintFuego checks totalSupply().add(numberOfTokens) against MAX_FUEGO.
mintFuego requires saleIsActive before any minting.
mintFuego compares block.timestamp with REVEAL_TIMESTAMP, making the reveal-index-block assignment timestamp dependent.
mintFuego reads REVEAL_TIMESTAMP for the reveal condition, a timestamp dependency on owner controlled state.
mintFuego writes startingIndexBlock when the reveal condition is met.
The constructor initializes MAX_FUEGO from the maxNftSupply argument.
The constructor computes REVEAL_TIMESTAMP = saleStart + (90000 * 9).
The maxNftSupply parameter is assigned into MAX_FUEGO.
The saleStart parameter participates in the REVEAL_TIMESTAMP addition.
withdrawAll pushes ETH with a low-level send and only requires the returned boolean to be true.
withdrawAll iterates over the withdrawAddresses array to pick recipients.
withdrawAll computes amount = contractBalance * withdrawPercents[i] / 100.
withdrawAll is guarded by onlyOwner which compares owner() with _msgSender().
The external send transfers the locally computed amount to the recipient.
withdrawAll caches address(this).balance before the payout loop.
setRevealTimestamp overwrites the reveal timing variable and is onlyOwner gated.
The onlyOwner modifier on setRevealTimestamp checks msg.sender against owner().
setProvenanceHash writes FUEGO_PROVENANCE and is onlyOwner gated.
The onlyOwner modifier on setProvenanceHash checks msg.sender against owner().
setBaseURI is onlyOwner gated, restricting metadata control to the owner.
flipSaleState toggles the saleIsActive state variable.
The onlyOwner modifier on flipSaleState checks msg.sender against owner().
setStartingIndex derives startingIndex from blockhash, an entropy source that is not truly random.
setStartingIndex writes the derived value into startingIndex.
setStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock as the blockhash source and validates it is non zero.
setStartingIndex applies modulo MAX_FUEGO to the blockhash value.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock assigns block.number into startingIndexBlock.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock requires startingIndex to still be zero.
The onlyOwner modifier on emergencySetStartingIndexBlock checks msg.sender against owner().
The numberOfTokens parameter drives the mint loops and the payment computation.
The revealTimeStamp parameter is written into REVEAL_TIMESTAMP.
The provenanceHash parameter is written into FUEGO_PROVENANCE.
The baseURI parameter is forwarded to _setBaseURI.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter exists only as the input written into REVEAL_TIMESTAMP by this setter and carries no independent semantics.
Parameter exists only as the value stored in FUEGO_PROVENANCE by this setter.
Parameter exists only to be forwarded into _setBaseURI by this setter.
User supplied mint count that only parameterises the loops, cap checks and price computation of mintFuego.
Transient loop counter inside mintFuego with no cross function meaning.
Transient token id derived from totalSupply() inside the mintFuego loop.
Temporary snapshot of totalSupply() used only inside reserveFuego.
Transient loop counter of the reserve mint loop.
Cached contract balance read only inside withdrawAll.
Transient index over withdrawAddresses inside withdrawAll.
Computed payout value that flows directly into the low-level send unsafe operation.
Deployment only argument passed to the ERC721 base constructor, subsumed by the constructor node.
Deployment only argument passed to the ERC721 base constructor, subsumed by the constructor node.
Deployment only argument assigned to MAX_FUEGO during construction.
Deployment only argument used in the REVEAL_TIMESTAMP arithmetic of the constructor.
